description: This file contains unit tests for the PcbNode class and related classes in the 'com.rusefi.pcb.test' package, primarily testing parsing, node relationships, and connection detection in PCB design data.

classes.name: PcbNodeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing PC Board node parsing, connection logic, and relationships.

methods.name: testParser
methods.description: Tests parsing of basic PcbNode structures from string representations and packing back into string format.

methods.name: testParseModule
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a complex ModuleNode with various PCB features and attributes, checking retrieval of reference designation.

methods.name: testConnected
methods.description: Checks if a ModuleNode is correctly identified as connected or disconnected to a specific segment based on the node's position.

methods.name: testSegmentConnected
methods.description: Tests whether segments are correctly identified as connected based on their endpoints, considering existing PCB nodes.

methods.name: testSegmentConnected2
methods.description: Further tests connection detection logic for a ModuleNode with multiple pads and a segment with a different start/end point.
